name: RC-B10-0070/2026 – Recital K
title: JOINT MOTION FOR A RESOLUTION on the attempted takeover of Lithuania’s public broadcaster and the threat to democracy in Lithuania
part_text: whereas the Lithuanian Prime Minister from this governing coalition had to resign in July 2025 following investigative journalism findings, including reporting by LRT, which raised serious concerns regarding his alleged involvement in corrupt practices; whereas later in 2025, legislative initiatives affecting LRT’s funding and governance triggered domestic and international concerns regarding media freedom and institutional independence;
